title: The Hidden Circle of Rainbows
hook: A rainbow is a full circle you never see.
script: A rainbow is a full circle you never see. But what if you could get high enough to see it all? The phenomenon forms at 42 degrees from the antisolar point, directly opposite the sun. Pilots have captured this complete circle from planes flying high above the Atlantic Ocean. It's not just rainbows; fogbows, formed in mist, also reveal hidden beauty. But here's the real twist: every rainbow is a private view, an angle that exists only for you.
